name: v4.0.526
body: ## What's Changed - [`@remotion/effects`: Add `lut()` for inline Cube color transforms](https://remotion.dev/docs/effects/lut) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11380 - `remotion`: Fix read-only Studio resize crashes with `` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11400 - `remotion`: Support credentialed images with effects by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11362 - `remotion`: Clamp negative `delayRender()` timeouts by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11375 - `@remotion/studio`: Make fontWeight keyframable by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11412 - `@remotion/studio`: Expand timeline properties when setting a keyframe by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11413 - `@remotion/studio`: Add "Copy image" right-click action by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11351 - `@remotion/studio`: Add "Copy frame" right-click action by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11381 - `@remotion/studio`: Show a preview of `.cube` files by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11388 - `@remotion/studio`: Make inspector sections collapsible by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11348 - `@remotion/studio`: Preview source in Fix computed value modal by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11387 - `@remotion/studio`: Restart with upgraded CLI by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11333 - `@remotion/studio`: Offer new composition when an Element drop cannot be inserted by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11378 - `@remotion/studio`: Hide unavailable settings in read-only Studio by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11399 - `@remotion/studio`: Restore Source Inspector asset actions by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11390 - `@remotion/studio`: Prevent selecting Inspector labels by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11352 - `@remotion/studio`: Fix duplicate Open in actions by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11383 - `@remotion/studio`: Fix code frame line numbers while scrolling by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11389 - `@remotion/studio`: Fix duplicated timeline rows flickering after deletion by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11397 - `@remotion/studio`: Speed up canvas outline ordering by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11363 - `@remotion/studio`: Reduce timeline row renders during selection by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11338 - `@remotion/studio`: Save folder operations without Prettier by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11336 - `@remotion/studio`: Save JSX duplication without Prettier by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11347 - `@remotion/studio`: Add "Generate with agent" interaction by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11414 - `@remotion/studio-codemods`: Reorder sequences without Prettier by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11367 - `@remotion/studio-codemods`: Split video and audio without Prettier by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11368 - `@remotion/studio-codemods`: Remove Prettier from default props updates by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11379 - `@remotion/studio-codemods`: Remove Prettier from remaining codemods by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11386 - `@remotion/captions`: Harden `parseSrt()` for pre-cue noise, CRLF, and dot-millis timestamps by @Copilot in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11360 - `@remotion/cli`: Fix `remotiond` startup under Deno by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11374 - `@remotion/whisper-webgpu`: Upgrade Transformers.js to 4.3.0 by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11366 ## Docs - Restructure License FAQ into topical sections by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11369 - Restyle Copy page button by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11395 ## Elements - Make third-party libraries discoverable by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11339 - Add third-party libraries to Studio by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11340 - Reframe libraries as third-party Elements by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11342 - Add Lexington Themes library by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11384 - Fix install dialog layout shifts by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11346 ## Internal - Remove recurrently flaky tests by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11350 - remotion.dev/brand: Add React Scan capture by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11344 - remotion.dev/brand: Fix `` timeline controls by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11385 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/compare/v4.0.525...v4.0.526
